name: Village Centre
tagline: The blue-and-white heart of the village
description: The cobbled main street climbing past whitewashed houses, studded blue doors, galleries and the historic Cafe des Nattes to the clifftop viewpoints. It is the most scenic and central area, though busiest with day trippers.
bestFor: Visitors wanting atmosphere, cafes and sea views within walking distance

name: Marina and Lighthouse
tagline: Harbour and clifftop below the village
description: The lower area around the Sidi Bou Said marina and the hilltop lighthouse, with boats, seafood restaurants and quieter walks. It offers waterfront dining and calmer evenings away from the main street crowds.
bestFor: Those wanting waterfront dining and a quieter, scenic base

name: La Marsa
description: A larger, greener seaside suburb just north of Sidi Bou Said with a long beach, a busy corniche, cafes, shops and coworking, making it a practical base with everyday amenities and easy transport into Tunis.
bestFor: Nomads wanting amenities, beach and coworking near the village

name: Carthage
description: The neighbouring residential area spread among the UNESCO ruins of ancient Carthage, with archaeological sites, embassies and quiet villa streets overlooking the gulf, a calm and historic base a short hop from Sidi Bou Said.
bestFor: History lovers wanting a quiet, spacious base near the sites
